note: CATIA navigation: the middle button alone pans; the middle button with a side button held turns the view; letting the side button go with the middle still down zooms; a middle click brings the point picked to the middle of the view, which moves the camera's target; a middle double-click fits. Other presets keep their own bindings.
The anchor alone pans: no turn, and the target moves.
A middle click with no drag recentres: marked again where the pan left the target, so the click has to move it by itself, and the distance stays put.
A side button held with the anchor turns the view.
That side button tapped instead, the anchor still down: the same drag zooms, pushing up to zoom in.
A one-button preset has no ladder: the same chord drag is a plain middle pan.
